title: Parents' Health Updates
content:
Mom's Health Update:

Blood Pressure: 130/85 mmHg, indicating a slightly elevated level. Dr. Smith has advised monitoring and lifestyle adjustments before considering medication.
Cholesterol Levels: Total cholesterol at 210 mg/dL, with LDL (bad cholesterol) at 140 mg/dL and HDL (good cholesterol) at 60 mg/dL. Dietary changes recommended to lower LDL levels.
Bone Density Scan: Shows signs of early osteopenia, particularly in the lumbar spine area. Calcium and vitamin D supplements have been prescribed, along with a recommendation for weight-bearing exercises.
Diagnosis: Overall, Mom is in good health for her age, but vigilance is required for her bone density and cardiovascular risk factors.
Dad's Health Update:

Blood Glucose Levels: Fasting glucose level at 105 mg/dL, indicating pre-diabetes. A referral to a nutritionist has been made to discuss dietary adjustments.
Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) Test: PSA levels are at 3.2 ng/mL, which is within the normal range but on the higher end. Dr. Lee recommends annual monitoring.
Echocardiogram: Results show mild aortic stenosis. Currently, it does not require intervention, but regular echocardiograms are recommended to monitor the condition.
Diagnosis: Dad's health is stable, with attention needed for managing his blood glucose levels and heart health.

title: Work Notes - Confidential
content: Meeting with Dr. Stevens about the new patient care protocols. Ensure all staff are updated on the privacy policy, especially regarding sharing medical test results.

title: Anniversary Party Plans
content: Organizing a surprise 40th-anniversary party for Mom and Dad. Booked the Sunnyside Community Hall for March 15th. Caterer confirmed. Finalizing the guest list this week.
